D.t: Marni von Wilpert leads by 13.2 in the forecast and wins 99% of simulations. The cushion is about 33,484 votes; a one point swing is about 1,267 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +5.8 and D +21.1. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$825K cash against $1.2M. Outspent: lean on earned media, digital, field and the outside groups, and pick the two or three media markets that decide it.

R.t: Jim Desmond trails by 13.2 and wins 1% of simulations. Closing it takes about 16,742 voters switching sides, or 33,484 more net votes from new turnout.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +21.1 and D +5.8. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$1.2M cash against $825K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
